_source: MMG_v19_Client_Manual_Testing_Guideline_FG05-FG14_v1.0.xlsx / Testing Guideline — pulled from the client's Drive on 2026-09-16. FG-10 'Shopify Storefront Integration' holds 4 cases in this workbook: TC-SHP-002, -016, -027 and -031. All 4 are implemented; 3 pass and 1 blocks on an authorisation the case itself asks for.
_target: The single ecommerce.channel on this database, 'Medicine Man Gallery' (#3), platform=shopify, status=connected, restored from production.
_safety: The store is the gallery's LIVE Shopify store and there is only one. Three of the four cases describe writes to it that this suite deliberately does not make. (1) disconnect() is not a flag: it archives the store AND its menus (omni_manage_channel/models/ecommerce_channel.py:339-345) and status is a computed mirror of active with an inverse (:75-77), so 'disconnected' IS 'archived'. The only way back is reconnect(), which calls check_connection() and therefore calls Shopify — forbidden by automation convention rule 4 — and the workbook's own step 10 says in capitals not to press it. (2) TC-SHP-027 step 7 flips the multi-warehouse switch and step 9 saves with the mapping list emptied; both write to the live store and neither is done. (3) The collections TC-SHP-016 and TC-SHP-031 create are real records, marked FG10-AUTOMATED-PROBE, left in Draft with no id_on_channel, and removed in a finally. publish / do_update / set_to_draft / get_data — the four buttons step 14 forbids — are never called by anything in this suite.
_method: Where the workbook asks a tester to watch a screen change, this suite reads the VIEW ARCH instead of performing the change. That is not a weaker substitute: an invisible= expression states the rule for every value of the field at once, where flipping a switch only ever demonstrates the two values it visits, and it cannot be satisfied by luck the way one observed screen can. The arch is read from ir.ui.view.arch_db rather than get_view, because assembly rewrites the attributes these cases turn on.

_findings.BC-FG10-001: THE COLLECTIONS SEARCH PANEL IS GONE. TC-SHP-016's first Expected Result reads 'the Collections list opens with a working search panel (Novobi added the search panel back during the upgrade — it was missing from an earlier build)'. MEASURED: there is NO search view for product.collection anywhere in multichannel_shopify, and the Collections action (ir.actions.act_window #1670) carries search_view_id = False. Odoo therefore serves its own generated fallback, <search string="Collection on Shopify"><field name="name"/></search> — a single Title box and nothing else. The v15 module HAD one: mmg_multichannel_shopify/views/product_collection_views.xml declares view_product_collection_search with a Title field AND a 'Group By > Type' filter. That module is on the not-ported list (FG-10b), and the search view went with it. Searching by title still works, which is exactly why this is easy to miss on a quick look — step 3 passes while Expected line 1 does not.
_findings.OBS-FG10-001: TC-SHP-016 STEP 12 CANNOT BE PERFORMED AS WRITTEN. Step 11 saves the collection; step 12 then says 'now switch Collection Type to Manual and confirm the Conditions group disappears'. The form declares <field name="type" readonly="write_date">, so once the record has been saved the radio is read-only and the switch cannot be made. The Expected Result it supports — 'switching to Manual hides the Conditions group; switching back shows it' — is still TRUE and is asserted from the Conditions group's own invisible="type == 'custom'", which is the rule both directions depend on. But a tester can only exercise it BEFORE the first save. Either the workbook's step order wants a fix, or the read-only lock does.
_findings.OBS-FG10-002: FOUR OF THE THIRTEEN Field VALUES LEAVE THE Condition DROPDOWN EMPTY. rule.collection.column offers 13 options; rule.relation, which supplies the Condition dropdown, covers only 9 of them. Picking product_taxonomy_node_id, is_price_reduced, product_metafield_definition or variant_metafield_definition leaves Condition empty while relation_id is required=True, so the row cannot be saved. This is deliberate and documented — multichannel_shopify/models/product_collection.py:65-67 says they are Shopify rule columns with no product.channel equivalent, accepted only so that importing a collection that uses one does not raise and roll back the whole channel creation. They exist for the importer, not for the user, and are worth hiding from the editor. TC-SHP-031 asserts that the empty set is exactly those four, so a fifth would be a real defect rather than this known one.
_findings.OBS-FG10-003: ON THIS STORE, TC-SHP-027 STEP 9's REFUSAL COMES FROM THE FORM, NOT THE CONSTRAINT. The server-side guard check_mapping_locations (multichannel_shopify/models/ecommerce_channel.py:94-110) raises 'There must be at least one line for location mapping.' only when has_multi_warehouses AND is_enable_inventory_sync AND the mapping list is empty. This store has inventory sync ON but multi-warehouse OFF, so the constraint would not fire; what refuses instead is the field's own required="is_enable_inventory_sync and platform == 'shopify'". Both are asserted. A tester who turns the switch on first meets the constraint; one who does not meets the form.
_findings.OBS-FG10-004: The form's Default Warehouse field is display_default_warehouse, a related="default_warehouse_id" writable alias declared so the label can read 'Default Warehouse' while the underlying field keeps its own string (ecommerce_channel.py:87-91). Recorded because a check written against the underlying name reports the field as missing while it is plainly on screen — which is what the first draft of TEST-FG10-SHP-027 did.

TC-SHP-002.reason: BLOCKED on the authorisation its own precondition demands — 'confirm with Novobi that it is acceptable to disconnect the store on this test copy, and agree who reconnects it afterwards' — plus step 10's DO NOT PRESS Reconnect. Everything the case can be judged on without the press is asserted and passes: the confirm= dialog and its exact wording, the Disconnect and Reconnect buttons' complementary invisible= expressions (so exactly one is ever shown), both badge colours on the Status column, the Overview card's matching classes, the Connected filter's domain [('active','=',True)] and why that is what makes the store vanish, and the ensure_operating() guard that refuses an export with a readable sentence before any request is built. NEEDS: Novobi's written go-ahead and an agreed reconnect owner.

TC-SHP-016.reason: PASSES. Creates UAT Collection 01 as an Automated collection with one rule and a description, and proves it lands in Draft with the rule intact, no id_on_channel and no published_at — which is what actually shows nothing was sent, rather than the Online Store flag, which defaults to True. The Conditions group's invisible="type == 'custom'" settles Expected lines 2 and 5 in one reading, both rule dropdowns are shown to be populated, and the weight note and the listing form's read-only/editable Collections pair are checked. Raises BC-FG10-001 (the missing search panel) and OBS-FG10-001 (step 12 blocked by the read-only type).

TC-SHP-027.reason: PASSES, entirely read-only. The multi-warehouse switch's two halves are proved complementary from the arch — Default Warehouse invisible="has_multi_warehouses", the mapping list invisible on the negation — so 'never both' holds for every value rather than the two a flip would visit. The refusal in step 9 is read from the @api.constrains and from the field's required=, and OBS-FG10-003 records which of the two this store would actually meet. The closing step re-reads the store and asserts every field is exactly as found, which is step 8's requirement met by never having broken it. Residual manual: ticking the location, the warehouse and the mapping rows off against the FG-08 TC-CHN-001 printout, which the platform does not hold.

TC-SHP-031.reason: PASSES. The Condition dropdown is a many2one narrowed at runtime by an onchange domain, not a selection, so the same domain [('columns','=ilike','%<field>%')] is applied per Field value exactly as the editor applies it — which is what makes step 4's 'not the same list for every field' checkable at all. Rules are shown to survive a save and reload unchanged, a collection to hold two different rows, a row to delete again, and the all/any choice to stick both ways. The Products group's list and its 'no products' message are proved to be complements, so the area is never blank. Raises OBS-FG10-002.
